generator: docs/brand-kit/_build/work/icons/build_icons.py (geometry source of truth; re-run to regenerate)

files.dark: not shipped as files: use the duotone file with #1B56FF swapped to #FFFFFF

contrast_wcag.note: Bright Cyan on white is below the 3:1 non-text guideline, so on light backgrounds the accent is emphasis only: every icon is identifiable from its Vibrant Blue strokes alone. On Deep Navy both colours pass.

rules: 48 x 48 grid, 4-unit safe padding: no ink outside 4..44 (checked on every render).
One stroke weight: 3 units, round caps, round joins, no fill.
Exactly one Bright Cyan accent element per icon; everything else Vibrant Blue.
Fills only for small accent solids (machine-learning output dot, automation run button).
Straight strokes and circular arcs only (the monogram's straight legs and round P bowl); the ribbon is the only free curve.
Rounded rectangles use a 4-unit corner radius.
A stroke that passes behind another stops 2 units short of it (round cap included).
A stroke that ends on another stroke is drawn beneath it, so the joint never shows a cap.
Path data is M/L/C/Z only (arcs converted to cubics) so Illustrator and kit.parse_d read it exactly.

motifs.ribbon: The AP monogram's swoosh, rebuilt as two tangent-continuous cubics with a level middle (swoosh() in the generator). Fitted to the swoosh centreline measured on original 11 the construction lands within 2.2 px mean (0.38% of the 583 px chord) with a 58 deg entry and a 90 deg exit into the P stem (verify/icon-ribbon-check.png). The icons keep the level middle but exit at 45-75 deg so the ribbon reads as forward motion at 24 px: growth (trend, 40/55), research-insights (signal, 50/75), launch (trail, 60/45).
motifs.bowl: Circular arcs from the P bowl: target rings, pie, woven rings, cloud lobes, lens, shoulders.
motifs.legs: Straight, uniform-weight strokes like the A legs: bars, check, gear flanks, network edges. The monogram's leg angle (65 deg, measured 64.7 deg on original 12) is not imposed; icon diagonals run at 45 deg, which renders cleaner on the pixel grid.

optical_balance.metric: rendered ink coverage at 48 px (sum of alpha, px^2)
optical_balance.note: dense glyphs (target, network, gear, pie) carry up to 42% more ink than open ones (growth, research); outer size is held by the keylines instead.

opaque_pixels_96px.note: the only off-palette opaque pixels are anti-aliased blends where a blue stroke meets the cyan accent (machine-learning edges into the output dot, the cap band under the mortarboard); everywhere else rendered colour is the exact hex (dE2000 0.0).

verification.svg_structure: all 24 files parsed: only path/circle/line elements, unique ids on every element, palette hex only, stroke 3/round/round, M/L/C/Z path data, one cyan element per duotone file, none in mono
verification.ribbon_vs_monogram: mean centreline error 2.22 px = 0.38% of chord (work/icons/ribbon_check.py)

icons.name: AI Strategy
icons.description: Target with an arrow home in the bullseye: a clear objective and the plan that reaches it.
icons.construction: Concentric rings r 14.5 and r 7 on centre (21, 27), both opened where the arrow enters (2-unit gap rule). The arrow runs at 45 deg from the centre to a two-feather fletching built on a 5.5-unit module in the top-right corner of the live area.

icons.name: Machine Learning
icons.description: A 1-3-1 neural network: one input fans out to a hidden layer that converges on a single prediction.
icons.construction: Node rings r 3.5 at x 9 / 24 / 39 (hidden layer at y 9.5 / 24 / 38.5). Edges are trimmed to the ring centrelines so their caps tuck under the rings. The prediction is the set's only solid dot (r 5, the same outer size as a ring).

icons.name: Automation
icons.description: A gear with a run button at its heart: processes that run themselves.
icons.construction: 8-tooth gear on (24, 24): tip radius 16.5, root radius 12.5, teeth 16 deg wide at the tip and 23 deg at the root, rotated 22.5 deg so a gap sits at 12 o'clock. Run button = small solid triangle with 1.5-unit corner radius (matching the round joins), centroid on the gear centre.

icons.name: Data & Analytics
icons.description: A pie chart with its key slice pulled out: the number that matters, separated from the rest.
icons.construction: Three-quarter pie r 15 on (22, 26), closed through its centre; the remaining quarter is offset 3 units up and right. Both are circular arcs (the P bowl construction).

icons.name: Partnership
icons.description: Two rings woven through each other: an alliance in which each partner sits at the centre of the other.
icons.construction: Rings r 12 with centres 12 apart, so each centre lies on the other ring (vesica piscis). Over-under weave: each ring breaks once, 2 units clear of the ring that crosses over it.

icons.name: Security & Governance
icons.description: A shield with a check: protected, compliant, approved.
icons.construction: Shield 30 x 37 (x 9-39, y 5.5-42.5): peaked top at 20 deg, vertical sides, mirrored curves to the point. The check is raised 1 unit to the shield's optical centre.

icons.name: Growth
icons.description: Rising bars under the brand ribbon, which lifts into an arrow.
icons.construction: Four bars on a 9.5-unit pitch, bottoms on y 41.5, each 4.5 units taller than the last. The trend is the ribbon (40 deg entry, level middle, 55 deg exit) ending in a 6-unit chevron.

icons.name: Cloud Integration
icons.description: A cloud with two systems plugged in beneath it, one connection highlighted.
icons.construction: Two-lobe cloud from circles r 10 and r 7 tangent to a flat base at y 27.5. Two drop links end in r 3.5 nodes; the links are drawn beneath the cloud so its base covers their caps.

icons.name: Advisory
icons.description: An advisor and a speech bubble: guidance, conversation, counsel.
icons.construction: Head r 6 over semicircular shoulders r 10 (the P bowl). The bubble is a 4-radius rounded rectangle whose lower-left corner becomes the tail, pointing back at the advisor.

icons.name: Training & Enablement
icons.description: A mortarboard: training, certification, capability building.
icons.construction: Board rhombus 36 x 15, cap band 23 wide with a rounded base, tassel on the right. Cap and tassel are drawn beneath the board so its edges cover their caps; the whole cap is centred on the grid.

icons.name: Research & Insights
icons.description: A magnifier that has found the signal: the brand ribbon, seen through the lens.
icons.construction: Lens r 13.5 on (20.5, 20.5), 45 deg handle to (41, 41). The ribbon inside (50 deg entry, level middle, 75 deg exit) is held 2 units clear of the lens.

icons.name: Launch
icons.description: A rocket on its way, riding the ribbon as its exhaust trail.
icons.construction: Rocket built upright (12-unit body, ogive nose, swept fins, r 3 window), then turned 45 deg. The ribbon trail rises from the bottom-left corner and stops short of the tail.
